title: Amalek first of nations
english: Balaam’s [[fifth and last vision >> Bible:Numbers 24:20-24]]. Seeing Amalek: [[Amalek is the first of the nations; their seed shall perish >> Bible:Numbers 24:20]].
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC (Numbers).
After Homilia XVIII; fifth oracle CLOSEOUT.
